Built for players

More than just a match.

A modern home for your gaming community — with match tools and verification features introduced in stages.

⚔

Flexible match formats

Plan casual challenges or tournaments, from solo matchups to team formats such as 2v2 and 5v5.

◎

Result review

Future screenshot analysis can help review match evidence. Disputed or unclear results should be checked by a person.

✦

Points, not cash bets

The first demo can use practice points only. Real-money features are not enabled in this version.

◉

Player community

A place to connect with other players and build your squad as community features are developed.

The zone is yours

Bring your game face.

CFP Game Zone is being built for mobile gamers who want a clear place to find matches, connect with other players, and submit results for review.

  • Works toward a mobile-first experience
  • COD Mobile, Free Fire and PUBG Mobile
  • Demo-first with practice points
  • Temporary screenshot storage planned

This is a design preview. Registration, live matches, AI analysis, and automatic deletion are not active until their services are connected and tested.

Ready when you are

Welcome to CFP Game Zone.

We’re shaping the first version now. The next step is publishing this design, then connecting the working player and match features.
